import sys, json, io, time
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import formats
from offline_discovery import rule_remove as rr
data=open('/tmp/hard2.json','rb').read()
p=formats.read_request(io.BytesIO(data))
spec=p['releases'][0]
rows=[(r['class'], tuple(rr.PAD and (r['values'][:r['values'].index(1514)] if 1514 in r['values'] else r['values']))) for r in spec['validation']]
# build bounds list like pipeline does
from offline_discovery.rule_generate import find_high_activation_snippets, clustering, cluster_bounds
frags=find_high_activation_snippets(spec['discovery'], spec['width'], 4096)
clusters,noise=clustering(frags, spec['classes'], spec['eps'], spec['ratio'])
ids=sorted(clusters)
bounds=[cluster_bounds(clusters[i],[frags[m][3] for m in clusters[i]['members']]) for i in ids]
print('patterns', len(bounds), 'rows', len(rows))
t=time.time(); res=rr.calibrate(bounds, rows, spec['classes']); print('calibrate %.2fs'%(time.time()-t))
# variant: pure boolean accumulation
matrix, prefix, labels, lengths = rr._prepare_rows(rows)
usable=int(np.searchsorted(-lengths,-2,side='right'))
sub=matrix[:usable]; pref=prefix[:,:usable]; lab=labels[:usable]
W=sub.shape[1]-1
t=time.time()
hits=[]
for b in bounds:
    possible = (pref[b[0][1]+1] != pref[b[0][0]]) & (pref[b[1][1]+1] != pref[b[1][0]])
    idx=np.nonzero(possible)[0]
    block=sub if idx.size==usable else sub[idx]
    lo,hi=b[0]
    cand=(block[:,0:W]>=lo)&(block[:,0:W]<=hi)
    lo,hi=b[1]
    cand &= (block[:,1:W+1]>=lo)&(block[:,1:W+1]<=hi)
    hit=cand.any(axis=1)
    if idx.size!=usable: hit_rows=lab[idx][hit]
    else: hit_rows=lab[hit]
    hits.append(np.bincount(hit_rows,minlength=2).tolist())
print('boolean variant %.2fs'%(time.time()-t))
print('same', hits==res)
EOF
